notes.title: Steam's Spring Sale has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/fa2a2a2e4791c0de5a2419323ea87c5f7ff80ee7.png[/img]

[h1][b]Steam's Spring Sale has arrived[/b][/h1], bringing unprecedented discounts! This spring, players around the world can dive into digital adventures and experience thrilling moments with their favorite games – all made possible by incredible discounts of up to 80% and beyond.

In F-Games, we aim to offer everyone the chance to experience something new and exciting, which is why we have selected a diverse range of games to suit every taste. Whether you are a passionate fan of strategy games, a master of fast-paced action games, or deeply immerse yourself in story-driven adventures, you are sure to find something that fascinates you.

Special highlights in this spring's sale include 'Voltage,' which takes players into a world filled with electric excitement, 'Seasonal Soccer,' offering a seasonal glimpse into the wonderful world of football, and 'RTS Commander,' a strategy game that challenges your tactical thinking and strategic planning to the limits.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/935340/Green_Dragon/?curator_clanid=40939311

https://store.steampowered.com/app/798710/Voltage/?curator_clanid=40939311

https://store.steampowered.com/app/765370/RTS_Commander_Smash_the_Rebels/?curator_clanid=40939311

https://store.steampowered.com/app/818380/Seasonal_Soccer/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698910/Hardcore_Trivia/

[b]Discounts also apply to the DLC:s![/b]

But don't let these titles limit your exploration – Steam offers thousands of games from every possible genre, providing endless entertainment and new experiences. This is your opportunity to build your dream game library or discover the next great game that takes you on entirely new adventures.

The Spring Sale is not only a fantastic opportunity to save on your favorite games but also a chance to support and experience the creations of indie developers who bring fresh ideas and innovative gameplay mechanics to the market. Whether your game budget is big or small, Steam's Spring Sale has something for everyone.

Remember, these incredible offers are only available for a limited time, until 3-21. So, don't miss your chance – dive into Steam's world of games and start your adventure today!

Best regards

F-Games

notes.title: New quiz added: European countries and territories flags Quiz.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/2e0c22af412fda0915c0ab99dbf42c0f661ca810.png[/img]

New quiz added: European countries and territories flags Quiz.
[h1]Current state of the game includes 60 questions, (6 themes), each have 4 options.[/h1]

Steam Playtest version has not been yet updated.

[b]Game currently include these challenging quizzes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)
[*] All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)
[*] Solar System Trivia (10 questions)
[*] General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)
[*] The Roman Empire Trivia (10 questions)
[*] European Flag Quiz (10 questions)
[/list]

Also couple of improvements added today:

[b]Added an option to return to the main menu after completed 10 questions.[/b]
[i]Cogwheel-icon (access to save game, load game) does not shown in the game for some reason, this bug is been investigated. However you can now access back to the main level after completed the level and choose new Quiz or Trivia, without no need to restart the whole game.[/i]

While adding this option to move to the main menu, we discovered another problem about points calculations. Fix: Needed to create variable to each level to get it work, since if using the same variable on theme 1, points continue to "follow" player to theme 2 etc.

Test your level! Each theme have points calculation system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/517a9565aaf2ed969bea01f1e103a3dd972c39f2.png[/img]

Best regards
Icany

notes.title: Welcome to Hardcore Trivia Store page
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/477a1ea70b481d3632ff570e3c40a19803c4943f.png[/img]

Hi and welcome to our Store Page!

We are currently working on a [b]Hardcore Trivia.[/b]
Hardcore Trivia is a fun and challenging game, which you can play on solo mode, with your friends or with a large amount of people. Challenge your brains and have a fun time with multiple challenging questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698910/Hardcore_Trivia/

Hardcore Trivia is aimed for two customer segments: 

[b]1:[/b] It offers a good entertainment for players on non-commercial version with a points calculation system. You can play it on solo-mode or get together to play with your friends. With multiple challenging questions, Hardcore Trivia put your brain to the test

[b]2:[/b] It is also suitable for companies and organisations, for example school clubs and pubs. If you are running a pub or school club, you can easily arrange an event where your host runs Hardcore Trivia and customers need to ques right answer. With Commercial licence, you can use ready-print questionnaire and offer a good entertainment to the customers.

[u]And best of all, you only need to buy Hardcore Trivia once, no monthly payments![/u]

[h2]Follow our new releases, updates and more:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40939311

[i][h3]Participating to Steam Next Fest - a celebration of upcoming games on October 2021![/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/85597a2a01d182354c03e9bb9ea0000ac544f586.png[/img]

We are glad to announce, that Hardcore Trivia is participating to Steam Next Fest. Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration where fans can try out demos, chat with developers, watch livestreams, and learn about upcoming games on Steam. 

Remember to add the game to your Wishlist! ːsteamhappyː

Best regards
[h3]F-Games[/h3]
